speaker: Monitor
text: Alert A0 says there may be an earthquake. Its source has not been checked.

speaker: Coordinator
text: Two other agents repeated A0. They cite the same original alert, not independent sensors.

speaker: Archivist
text: The link behind A0 resolves to an archived drill page. The date needs checking.

speaker: Verifier
text: The archived page labels A0 as a practice alert from last year; the original repost retained its identifier.

speaker: Monitor
text: A new official alert A1 now reports an actual earthquake today. It is a different alert with a different identifier.

speaker: Verifier
text: The audit matches A0 to the old drill page and A1 to today’s real event. The original alert A0 was a reposted drill.
